value.rationale: The exact two-cycle sector is a natural part of the recently studied ring-spectrum and classical kink dynamics of ECA18. A universal closed zeta and full count recurrence, precise existence semigroup with exceptional ring length 7, and plastic-constant entropy provide a complete structural classification across all rings. They distinguish multiplicity growth from the previously studied maximal cycle lengths and permit exact ring-size predictions, rather than simply enumerating an arbitrary short list.
